# Test fixtures: provenance

All files here are synthetic or captured from throwaway setups. None contains real personal data. The only
private key is in `state-v1/` (see below); it protects nothing.

| Path | What it is | Provenance |
|---|---|---|
| `kdeconnect-real/` | Packets written by a stock KDE Connect desktop daemon (kdeconnectd 26.08.2) talking to GeekBridge in a throw-away network namespace, plus the two **public** certificates of that run | Captured with `scripts/interop-kdeconnect.sh`; see the README inside. KDE Connect is GPL software; the files are protocol data (JSON packets), not source code. |
| `kdeconnect-android-real/` | Packets written by the stock KDE Connect Android app (F-Droid build 1.37.0) running in an emulator against GeekBridge | See the README inside. Synthetic contact and SMS. |
| `a.crt.pem`, `b.crt.pem` | Throwaway test certificates (public part only) generated for the pairing tests | Generated with `openssl` for these tests. |
| `state-v1/` | Golden state files at format 1 (see `docs/state-formats.md`) | Generated by this code base. `identity.pem` holds a **throwaway** private key created only for this fixture; it is not used anywhere else. Secret scanners may flag it: it is intentionally public test data. |

Regenerate: `docs/kdeconnect-interop.md` ("Reproducing"). No fixture may be edited by hand except to replace
the machine hostname in `deviceName`.
